identificationModule.briefTitle: Sintilimab in Combination With Gemcitabine and Platinum-Based Chemotherapy as First-Line Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Squamous NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Sintilimab (IBI308) in Combination With Gemcitabine and Platinum-Based Chemotherapy vs. Placebo in Combination With Gemcitabine and Platinum-Based Chemotherapy as First-Line Treatment for Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Squamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (ORIENT-12)

armGroups.label: Sintilimab+ gemcitabine plus platinum
armGroups.description: Sintilimab combination arm: Sintilimab in combination with gemcitabine plus cisplatin or carboplatin

armGroups.label: Placebo+gemcitabine plus platinum
armGroups.description: Placebo combination arm: Placebo in combination with gemcitabine plus cisplatin or carboplatin

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: 1000mg/m\^2, Q3W, day 1and 8, I.V.; first 4 or 6 consecutive cycles.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: 75 mg/m\^2, Q3W, day1, I.V.; first 4 or 6 consecutive cycles.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: NA, Q3W, day1, I.V.; consecutive cycles

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: AUC 5mg/ml/min, Q3W, day1, I.V.; first 4 or 6 consecutive cycles.
